gaps.sentence: The new hall is ___ far the largest building on campus.
gaps.explanation: 'By far' strengthens a superlative: by far the largest.

gaps.sentence: He stayed ___ touch with every colleague he'd ever had.
The negotiations broke down ___ the very brink of success.
gaps.explanation: 'on the brink of' = on the point of.

gaps.sentence: He denied everything ___ the face of the evidence.
gaps.hint: ___ the face of = when confronted with
gaps.explanation: 'in the face of' = despite / when confronted by.

gaps.sentence: The bus was so crowded that we travelled ___ discomfort.
The matter went completely ___ my head — I cannot recall a thing.
gaps.explanation: 'Over one's head' = too complicated to understand.

gaps.sentence: ___ first, the plan sounded ridiculous — then it grew on us.
gaps.explanation: 'At first' = in the beginning (contrast with 'first' = before anything else).

gaps.sentence: He did it ___ purpose, just to annoy her.
